title: The Hidden Symmetries of Yang-Mills Theory in (1+1)-dimensions
summary: We present an integral formulation of classical Yang-Mills theory coupled to fermionic and scalar matter fields in (1+1)-dimensional Minkowski spacetime. By reformulating the local dynamics in terms of loop-space holonomies, we demonstrate that the path independence of the holonomy eigenvalues constitutes a conservation law, yielding an infinite hierarchy of gauge-invariant, dynamically conserved charges.
